newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African helicopter crashes near Johannesburg.
newsitem.headline: S.African helicopter crashes near Johannesburg.

text.p: A helicopter crashed near Johannesburg on Friday and at least one person was seriously injured, South African officials said.
Police Superintendent Eugene Opperman said emergency services were at the scene, but it was not clear how many people had been hurt.
It was not known what caused the helicopter to go down in Midrand, about 20 km (12 miles) north of Johannesburg.
Johannesburg's independent Radio 702 reported that one person had been flown to hospital in serious condition.
